# Reduced

```{r data}
readRDS("data/sub.mod.data.1") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(dbh, H)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ log(x)) +
  xlab("dbh [ cm ]") + ylab("h [ m ]") + 
  facet_wrap(~ system) +
  ggtitle("10% dataset", "9,002 observations")
```
